# Levich Toys

> Guangdong Levich Toys Co., Ltd. is a toy manufacturer based in Chenghai, Shantou, China. Founded in 2015, we produce beach toys, bubble toys, remote control toys and plastic building blocks for brands worldwide. OEM/ODM customization, BSCI and ISO 9001 certified factory, 20,000 m² production facility with 7-day sampling and 20-25 day mass production.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.levichtoys.com/): Product overview, factory introduction and manufacturing capability
- [Products](https://www.levichtoys.com/products): Browse all toy categories and individual products
- [Beach Toys](https://www.levichtoys.com/products/beach-toys): Beach buckets, sand toys, shovels, rakes and outdoor play sets
- [Bubble Toys](https://www.levichtoys.com/products/bubble-toys): Bubble wands, bubble guns, automatic bubble machines and accessories
- [RC Toys](https://www.levichtoys.com/products/rc-toys): RC cars, stunt cars, RC trucks, racing cars and RC helicopters
- [Building Blocks](https://www.levichtoys.com/products/building-blocks): Plastic building blocks, educational STEM blocks and construction sets
- [OEM & Customization](https://www.levichtoys.com/oem): Custom product development, logo printing, packaging and mold services
- [About Us](https://www.levichtoys.com/about): Factory background, certifications and production capability
- [Blog](https://www.levichtoys.com/blog): Toy industry guides, manufacturing insights and product development tips
- [Contact](https://www.levichtoys.com/contact): Request a quote or send inquiry

## Key Facts

- **Location**: Huafu Fuhua South Road, Guangyi Subdistrict, Chenghai District, Shantou, Guangdong, China
- **Founded**: 2015
- **Factory Size**: 20,000 m² production area, 5,000 m² warehouse
- **Main Products**: Beach toys, bubble toys, remote control toys, plastic building blocks
- **Services**: OEM/ODM, custom packaging, logo printing, mold development, quality control, export documentation
- **Certifications**: BSCI, ISO 9001
- **Sampling Lead Time**: 7 days
- **Mass Production Lead Time**: 20-25 days
- **Markets**: North America, Europe, Middle East, South America, Asia Pacific (20+ countries)
